race.comment: BUNDORAN (3) has her hoof on the till after the two minor placings and ready for the 1200m today. Stalked the speed and closed late with a game third over 1100m at Armidale. With fitness on her side she can overcome the sticky gate. Go close. TOTALLY UNDERRATED (10) excellent return from a lengthy break with a game on pace second over 1100m at Armidale. Claim helps from the better gate and finds a suitable race. SYLLABLE (5) has finished runner-up at her two runs back and the visors go on today. Stuck on well to run second over 1200m here. Similar set-up today and can take a hand in the finish. SUPER VITALITY (9) showed ability in the first campaign and resumes today. Primed with the two searching trials and gets every chance from the low draw.
